# Visit Guilin — Guilin Travel Guide & Private Tours for International Travelers

> Last updated: July 2026

> Visit Guilin is an English-language travel guide and private-tour service for international visitors to Guilin, China. It covers the Li River cruise, karst limestone peaks, Longji rice terraces, Reed Flute Cave, Yulong River bamboo rafting, Elephant Trunk Hill, the Sun & Moon Pagodas, and Xingping ancient town — with practical planning info: best time to visit, how to get there, tickets, suggested routes, and FAQs. Content is written and reviewed by a local Guilin team, and prices/routes are checked regularly.

## Top destinations

- [Li River (漓江)](https://myguilin.com/attractions/liriver.html): China's Most Scenic River Journey · Guilin–Yangshuo
- [Elephant Trunk Hill (象鼻山)](https://myguilin.com/attractions/elephant.html): Guilin's City Symbol · On the Li River
- [Yangshuo & West Street (阳朔)](https://myguilin.com/attractions/yangshuo.html): Karst Countryside & Nightlife · 65 km from Guilin
- [Longji Rice Terraces (龙脊)](https://myguilin.com/attractions/longji.html): Dragon-Back Terraces · ~100 km from Guilin
- [Reed Flute Cave (芦笛岩)](https://myguilin.com/attractions/reedflute.html): Nature's Underground Palace · 5 km NW of Guilin
- [Yulong River Rafting (遇龙河)](https://myguilin.com/attractions/yulong.html): The Little Li River · Just outside Yangshuo
- [Two Rivers & Four Lakes (两江四湖)](https://myguilin.com/attractions/tworivers.html): Guilin's Water Ring · City Center
- [Xingping Ancient Town (兴坪古镇)](https://myguilin.com/attractions/xingping.html): The 20-Yuan Banknote Village · On the Li River

## Experiences (hands-on activities)

- [Li River Cruise (漓江游船)](https://myguilin.com/experiences/li-river-cruise.html): China's Most Famous Scenic River Journey · Guilin to Yangshuo
- [Countryside Cycling (阳朔乡村骑行)](https://myguilin.com/experiences/countryside-cycling.html): Pedal Through Rice Fields and Karst Peaks Around Yangshuo
- [Longji Terraces Trek (龙脊梯田徒步)](https://myguilin.com/experiences/longji-terraces-trek.html): Hike Among Mirror-Like Rice Terraces and Minority Villages
- [Cormorant Fishing (漓江鸬鹚捕鱼)](https://myguilin.com/experiences/cormorant-fishing.html): Watch a Centuries-Old Fishing Tradition at Dusk on the Li River
- [Bamboo Rafting (遇龙河竹筏)](https://myguilin.com/experiences/bamboo-rafting.html): Float the Quiet Yulong River on a Bamboo Raft
- [Rock Climbing (阳朔攀岩)](https://myguilin.com/experiences/rock-climbing.html): Scale World-Class Limestone Karst Towers in Yangshuo
- [Cooking Class (桂林烹饪课)](https://myguilin.com/experiences/cooking-class.html): Shop Local Markets and Cook Guilin Classics with English-Speaking Chefs
- [Sunrise Viewpoint (相公山日出)](https://myguilin.com/experiences/sunrise-viewpoint.html): Climb Xianggong Mountain for the Best Sunrise View in Guilin

## Hotels (where to stay)

- [Scenic-View Hotels (山水景观酒店)](https://myguilin.com/hotels/scenic-view.html): Rooms that frame the karst — mountain views, terraces and riverside calm.
- [Curated Stays (精选酒店)](https://myguilin.com/hotels/selected.html): Hand-picked properties with character, service and standout design.
- [Great-Value Stays (性价比酒店)](https://myguilin.com/hotels/budget.html): Comfortable, well-located rooms that leave more budget for experiences.
- [Hotels by Area (区域酒店)](https://myguilin.com/hotels/region.html): Pick your base first — Yangshuo is ready now; more areas coming soon.

## Food (where to eat)

- [Guilin Food Guide (桂林美食)](https://myguilin.com/food/guide.html): What to eat, where to find it, and how to order like a local.
- [Featured Restaurants (特色餐厅)](https://myguilin.com/food/featured.html): Scenic, characterful and experience-led tables worth the trip.
- [Chinese Restaurants (中餐厅)](https://myguilin.com/food/chinese.html): Local Guilin cooking, Guangxi fusion and home-style favorites.
- [Western & International (西餐与国际)](https://myguilin.com/food/western.html): Pizza, Indian, cafés and grills — a familiar break when you need it.
- [Must-Eat List (必吃榜)](https://myguilin.com/food/must-eat.html): The shortlist we’d give a friend with three days in town.
